objective: Require ordinary teaching production route-smoke evidence to prove unsafe path identifiers are rejected on export manifest download, gradebook release/rollback, and backup restore direct-call routes.

codeReferences.summary: The aggregate production release gate now requires unsafeExportManifestIdDenied in teaching operations route-smoke evidence.
The aggregate production release gate now requires unsafeGradebookReleaseObjectIdDenied and unsafeGradebookRollbackObjectIdDenied.
The aggregate production release gate now requires unsafeBackupRestoreIdDenied.
The ordinary teaching route-smoke script probes an authenticated unsafe export manifest id direct call.
Route-smoke output marks unsafeExportManifestIdDenied only when the response is a redacted 400 with matching trace header and no unsafe id echo.
Route-smoke output marks gradebook unsafe release and rollback object ids as proved only through redacted 400 denials.
Route-smoke output marks unsafeBackupRestoreIdDenied only when the backup restore route denies the unsafe id before restore planning.
Shared unsafe path-id denial checker verifies HTTP 400, trace binding, redaction, and no unsafe id echo.
Local production smoke proof summary stays aligned with the new export unsafe-id result.
Local production smoke proof summary stays aligned with the new gradebook unsafe-id results.
Local production smoke proof summary stays aligned with the new backup restore unsafe-id result.
Regression proves stale teaching operations route-smoke evidence that omits unsafe path-id denial proof blocks release.
Live route-smoke mock now exercises the unsafe export manifest route and returns a redacted 400.
Live route-smoke expected results include unsafeExportManifestIdDenied.
Live route-smoke expected results include unsafeBackupRestoreIdDenied.
Live route-smoke expected results include gradebook unsafe object-id denials.
The LRS privacy-guard fixture now uses a long-lived app-session cookie so the test does not expire after 2026-06-27.

securityPosture.ordinaryTeachingRouteSmoke: Production route-smoke evidence must now prove authenticated unsafe path identifiers return redacted 400 responses for export manifest download, gradebook release, gradebook rollback, and backup restore.
securityPosture.directCallRisk: The aggregate release gate no longer accepts ordinary teaching route-smoke evidence that only proves happy-path readback and legacy auth denials while omitting authenticated unsafe-id denial probes.
securityPosture.redaction: The route-smoke checker rejects evidence unless the response omits both the raw unsafe id and its encoded form.
securityPosture.localProductionParity: The local production smoke proof summary now matches the aggregate release-gate required result list.

aggregateEnterpriseGateImpact.summary: This closes a production-gate coverage gap for ordinary teaching direct-call safe-id proof. The full enterprise gate still requires same-run owner-approved production evidence for env placement, deployment, storage, ordinary teaching route/browser smokes, app-auth readiness, browser workflow smoke, and live provider generation.
